title: Rate Cut Doesn't Mean Cheaper Loans
hook: Everyone's celebrating the rate cut. But your bank isn't going to reduce your EMI automatically.
body: Banks take 3-6 months to pass rate cuts. Some never fully pass them. You need to call your bank and explicitly ask for a rate revision. MCLR-linked loans adjust slower than repo-linked ones.

title: Don't Buy Gold at 85,000
hook: Gold just hit 85,000. Your relatives are telling you to buy. Please don't.
body: Every time gold hits an all-time high, retail investors pile in. Then it corrects 10-15%. In 2012, gold hit 32,000 and took 7 years to recover. If you must buy, use SGB or Gold ETF — never physical gold with making charges.

title: FDs Are NOT the Safest Investment
hook: Your parents say FD is the safest. But they don't know about this one risk.

title: Save 1.5 Lakh Tax With This One Trick
hook: Most people save 50K on taxes. Top 1% save 1.5 lakhs. The difference? They use Section 80CCD(2).
